name: Ma Earth Funding Rounds
summary: Matched crowdfunding rounds for established, community-led nature projects anywhere. Accepted projects raise donations from their own supporters, which unlock a share of a matching pool; the more individual donors a project has, the more matching money it gets, so the total is not fixed in advance.
reporting: Projects commit to regular documentation and evaluation of their results, through their own reports and third-party assessments.
